fixtures.preview: United host Villa on Sunday 8 Nov (4:30pm UK, 3:30am Mon 9 Nov Sydney) after a 3-2 comeback over Roma in the Champions League.
talking_points: United came from 2-0 down to beat Roma, a rare win in a season with just one Premier League victory so far.
Carlos Baleba is out with a hamstring injury and Carrick says he will miss 'a number of weeks'.
Lisandro Martinez is suspended; Sesko, Ugarte and Shaw are out, and Rashford, Dorgu and Wan-Bissaka are doubts, with Maguire also a doubt after limping off.
Villa arrive after their first Champions League defeat of the season, to Barcelona, and are without suspended Matty Cash and the injured Onana and Ruggeri.

fixtures.preview: The trip to Anfield is set for Sunday 22 November at 4:30pm UK time (3:30am Mon 23 Nov Sydney).
Matchday 5 in Lisbon, listed by UEFA at 21:00 CET (7am Thu 26 Nov Sydney).
Brentford visit on Saturday 28 Nov at 3pm UK time (2am Sun 29 Nov Sydney), United's first 3pm Saturday kick-off of the season.
Sydney travel to Brisbane (6:40pm Brisbane time, 7:40pm Sydney) after beating the Mariners 4-1 on Friday night.
talking_points: Al Hassan Toure scored a hat-trick against the Mariners, his second for the club, and Gabriel Popovic scored his first Sydney FC goal.
The win bounced Sydney back after a 2-1 loss at Melbourne City on 31 Oct.
Loan signing Jacob Farrell was in line to debut and Gus Hoefsloot returned from a wrist injury; Abel Walatee (ankle) and Jake Hollman (hamstring) were unavailable pre-match.
